## What you did

Which steps of create → save → place → open on desktop → open on a phone → remove did you try?

## What happened

Include console errors and a screenshot where helpful. Say whether it happens with a default theme (Twenty Twenty-Five) and with the other plugins disabled. See [docs/compatibility.md](../../docs/compatibility.md) for combinations already recorded.

Do not include passwords, private URLs or unredacted menu exports.
